title: Triple failures at every sector order: the corrected and expanded hardness proof
claim: Successor of COPRIME-DICHOTOMY-20261027-001C-P001 (frozen). p >= 5, r | p - 1, n graded of class at most 4 with a grading-preserving C_r action, d | r. If (P2_d) holds (so the parity map theta_d is an automorphism compatible with the action; the action itself need not factor through C2) and (P3_d) fails, counting |Hom(pi_1 S^3_(d/p)(K), G)| over knot diagrams is #P-hard. Corrections: the literal Fox matrix of the closure relators is t^-1 (Bur_t - I), with the column space of I - Bur_t; the cable homomorphism uses the integer abelianization exponent; the edge weight is used with its actual coefficients. Expansions: canonical pinned coordinates on which the amphichiral symmetry acts linearly (odd layer-2 parts are cocycles, even parts are unique, odd layer-3 parts do not reach odd layer-4 obstructions); reading strands nonzero at every root character with a basis proof for both summand families (cable colourings are bundle constants; two-partition lemma plus conjugation for amphichiral summands).
failure_conditions: A braid on which the literal Fox closure rows differ from t^-1 (Bur_t - I), or a cable (k,1) of T(2,p) whose fixed colourings at some t with t^k = -1 are not exactly the bundle constants.
A pinned map built with the integer exponent that fails a relator, or a cable summand with theta' of order greater than two on which some datum fails to lift.
A pair-quotient algebra in which an odd layer-2 defect, an odd-by-odd layer-4 bracket of odd character, or an unbalanced odd triple bracket is nonzero.
A summand braid for which no strand pair separates the classes at every root character, or an edge-weight count with the actual coefficients that fails 0 < f(0, s*) < f(0).
foundation_claim_scope: p >= 5, r | p - 1, graded nilpotent Lie algebras of class at most 4 with a grading-preserving C_r action; manifolds S^3_(d/p)(K) (H1 = Z/d). Cited with precise references in proof.md: Lazard; Schur-Zassenhaus; Schubert's classification and invertibility of two-bridge knots; the satellite decomposition; Lefschetz duality with local coefficients; universal coefficients over F_p[t, 1/t]; Squier's unitarity (here verified directly); Bulatov-Grohe via Cai-Chen-Lu; Lemma I. Not covered: pair failures in classes 3 and 4, classes at least 5, non-graded algebras, p = 2, 3, knot exteriors. r counts the characters of the action, not Boolean variables. No P versus NP claim.

validation.status: checked: literal Fox closure rows equal t^-1 (Bur_t - I) at 240 characters of random braids; Squier form and reversed Artin identity replayed; on eight pair quotients only balanced triple shapes and no parity violations, and on five knot models (chiral and amphichiral, class-4 algebras) odd layer-2 residuals vanish and odd layer-4 residuals do not depend on odd layer-3 cocycles while even ones do; Bur_t(delta_k) characteristic polynomials (258 cases); fixed colourings of (k,1)-cables are bundle constants at t^k = -1 (eight (p,k)); the integer-exponent map with theta' of order 6 satisfies the T(2,13) relators; data lift on cables at eight (p,d,k) for four algebras; two-partition lemma exhaustive for n <= 6 and 120 conjugated amphichiral representatives separated; exact edge counts with a direct exponential sum including kappa; three gadget replications including a conjugated figure-eight; the independent AI review of the predecessor (Codex, V2 finite checks) is recorded; no human or external review
